implementation_status: Shared Scorch and Ignition state transitions are partial, with explicit calibration dependencies and synthetic test profiles; Incandescent is not implemented.

sources.claim: Melee damage increases no longer scale Scorch or Ignition generated by melee; this does not supply decay or tick timings.

incandescent_reference.rank_multiplier: source explicitly excludes combatant rank multipliers for this explosion and its Scorch; reconcile with general Solar scaling before assembly

pve_scorch.duration_and_decay: difficulty-dependent; no numeric per-difficulty table in this cell

solar_format_findings.nonlethal_scope: Text says Scorch damage is non-lethal after the red PvP examples, but the phrase itself uses keyword colors; confirm exact target scope before adding health-floor policy.
solar_format_findings.interpretation: Color mapping is verified against original Landing F22/M22 CSS. Do not apply the red decay values to PvE or fit a universal damage formula from the mixed CSV text.

ignition_reference.inheritance: Initial Scorch source determines weapon/ability credit; exact modifier sampling, source replacement and special cases need explicit policy and evidence.

stored_damage_snapshots.semantics: Immutable full attacks survive independent Buff events, refresh, source expiry/detach and ended-generation reads; explicit overwrite/clear is content-controlled.
stored_damage_snapshots.limitation: This carrier does not decide Scorch modifier sampling, first-source write policy, tick/decay behavior or restart persistence.

shared_solar.sampling_policy: First application captures dot, nonlethal dot and ignition attacks; source-side on_use values and credit remain frozen; tick stacks, observed target classification and defenses remain live. Not all Destiny sampling rules are calibrated.
shared_solar.timing_policy: First tick at 0.5s, second at 1.43s, subsequent intervals 0.56s. Reapplication refreshes decay but not tick cadence; first stack decays at the hold deadline. These boundary interpretations require in-game calibration.
shared_solar.host_contract: Bind solar_scaling once per source owner before capture; declare mutually exclusive source damage credit tags; producers check target scorch_lockout before applying status. The test producer is not production equipment assembly.
